dependsOn.guidance: Briefs that must be built before this one — usually the database models this resource reads or writes.

instructions.when: For each resource (a group of related operations) an API needs. One file per resource. Lives in the API's solution folder; the API itself is defined in that folder's application-spec.json.
instructions.how: Answer in plain English. Then hand it to your AI using the bridge in ai-only/1-translate-for-ai.md, along with the page and any data models it touches.
instructions.deliverableNote: Which deliverable from the Project Brief this works towards, e.g. MVP. Builds say which deliverable each change advances, and stop when the last item for one is built so people can evaluate direction.
instructions.signoffNote: Before this is built, Developers (and Product, if the resource changes what customers see) agree how it will be built and sign buildSignoff as "<names> <YYYY-MM-DD> round <n>", and QA reviews it in qa/. /build will not start until both are done for the current round; a new entry in changesOverTime needs a new sign-off.
instructions.note: Solution = the folder this file sits in.

purpose.question: In one line, what is this resource for?
purpose.example: Create, log in, and manage users.

operations.guidance: One entry per operation. "whoCanCall" uses the roles/claims from the Project Brief.

request.question: What does each operation expect in the body?
request.guidance: Show the shape per operation, keyed by operation name. Mark which fields are required.

response.question: What does each operation return?
response.guidance: Describe the shape, and which data model(s) it comes from (the model files in the Database solution).

dataModels.question: Which data models does it read or write?

limits.question: Any limits (rate limits, page size, max payload)?

watchOutFor.question: Anything to watch out for (side effects, things that must not happen twice)?

developerReview.guidance: Developers answer, then talk it through with Product where it touches what they asked for.

betterWay.question: Can we build this, or is there a better way?

errors.question: What happens with errors, and with scenarios that could occur?

aiTests.question: What tests should the AI create, on top of the project's testing floor?

questionsForProduct.question: What questions do we have for Product?

acceptedDebt.guidance: Debt the team has decided to live with, for now, and why — named as the build named it (D1, D2, …). To pay a debt down instead, name it in a changesOverTime round: "pay down D2 — …".

exampleEntry.why: Only one caller today; worth fixing when there is a second.

changesOverTime.guidance: You don't fill this in at the start. Each time you come back to change this resource, add an entry describing what should change. Keep changes small.

exampleEntry.change: Add a DELETE operation, Admin only.
